claim: a simple pre-registered feature rule (vmin_zone < 45.0 mV, fixed on the exp150 deposit before any exp153 decode) separates decode-pass from decode-fail on the expanded delivered cohort and is actionable as a generator-side filter that lifts C3 to >= 9/10
verdict: RULE NOT ESTABLISHED (3/4 gates; feature table deposited; mechanism-level attribution registered as NEXT)
stage_order: rule_declared (docstring + module constant, before any decode call)

rule.name: R_U vmin gap rule
rule.feature_def: min over the anatomy's zones of |voltage| [mV]

predicted_verdict.true: decode-pass (C3 semantics at exp150's frozen emission)

rule.fitted_on: results/exp150_generator_complete.json ONLY — the 10 deposited delivered anatomies and their deposited decode verdicts; no exp153 decode had run when the threshold was fixed

fitted_gap.gap: (40.8, 48.6) — any threshold inside is equivalent on the fitted data; 45.0 fixed

rule.form: single feature, single threshold, zero knobs
rule.applied_as: generator-side filter: deliver only predicted-pass inventions (U2 simulation); cohort prediction (U1)

gates.U1: rule accuracy >= 90% on the expanded cohort (C3 verdicts at exp150's frozen emission)
gates.U2: predicted-pass-only delivery (frozen bars, cap 10) yields exactly 10 with C3 >= 9/10
gates.U3: rule declared before the expanded decodes (docstring + constant precede the first decode-call path, byte-offset asserted)
gates.U4: bit-exact reproduction of exp150's deposited ladders/emissions/verdicts on the original 10
